title: DAGFormer: Global Topology Prediction for Transformer Cross-Layer Connections
abstract: arXiv:2610.19625v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose DAGFormer, a Transformer language model whose cross-layer connections are planned by a jointly trained topology predictor. Beyond the residual connections in a standard Transformer, DAGFormer adds direct connections from earlier layers to later ones, and the predictor controls the strength of every connection based on input tokens. Unlike existing cross-layer routing architectures, which set each layer's connections separately, DAGFormer plans the routing of the whole model at once. On matched OLMo-2 pairs from 75M to 1B parameters, DAGFormer lowers WikiText-2 perplexity by 17% to 25% over the vanilla Transformer, and a 1B DAGFormer trained on 5B tokens outperforms the vanilla model trained on 10B. Against four routing baselines with the same data and budget, it reaches the lowest perplexity at 75M, 300M and 1B. translated_title: DAGFormer：面向Transformer跨层连接的全局拓扑预测
translated_abstract: 我们提出DAGFormer，一种由联合训练的拓扑预测器来规划跨层连接的Transformer语言模型。在标准Transformer残差连接之外，DAGFormer增加了从较早层到较晚层的直接连接，预测器基于输入词元控制每条连接的强度。与现有跨层路由架构逐层单独设置连接的方式不同，DAGFormer一次性规划整个模型的路由。在参数量从75M到1B的匹配OLMo-2模型对上，DAGFormer比原始Transformer在WikiText-2困惑度上降低17%至25%；在50亿词元上训练的1B DAGFormer优于在100亿词元上训练的原始模型。在与四个路由基线使用相同数据和预算的对比中，它在75M、300M和1B三个规模上均取得最低困惑度。该增益还延续到13项常识、科学、阅读和数学评测任务上（平均高出2.0至2.5分）。
tldr: DAGFormer通过联合训练的拓扑预测器一次性规划整个Transformer模型的全局跨层连接拓扑，在75M至1B多个规模上将困惑度降低17%至25%，并全面超越逐层路由方法。
en_tdlr: DAGFormer uses a jointly trained topology predictor to plan global cross-layer connections for the entire Transformer at once, reducing perplexity by 17–25% across 75M to 1B scales and outperforming layer-wise routing baselines.
